people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
translations.bsb: On the contrary, we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”
translations.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
translations.asv: But we believe that we shall be saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, in like manner as they.
